pages.text: A $(item)Mob Ward$() stops monsters spawning for a good distance around it. You'll need pieces of the Obsidilith and an Ancient Anima to build one. Worth it.

For anything that walks up anyway: $(l)Create Big Cannons$(). Cast a barrel, mount it, load powder and shot. Aim with $(l)C$() while manning it.$(br2)Light keeps most things away. Not all things. Doors keep out fewer than you'd think.
